mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_order p INNER JOIN t_prepay_order pr ON pr.payment_order_id = p.payment_order_id WHERE p.status IN ('PREPAY_CREATED', 'WAIT_CALLBACK') AND pr.expires_at < NOW() ), 0) AS expiredPaymentCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_order WHERE status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' ), 0) AS pendingCallbackCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_event WHERE publish_status = 'FAILED' ), 0) AS failedEventCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_refund_order WHERE status = 'FAIL' ), 0) AS failedRefundCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM t_payment_day_end_batch WHERE batch_status = 'WARNING' ), 0) AS warningDayEndBatchCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT po.created_at, 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_order po WHERE po.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' UNION ALL SELECT pnl.created_at, 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_notify_log pnl WHERE pnl.notify_status = '待处理' UNION ALL SELECT pe.created_at, 'P2' AS severity FROM t_payment_event pe WHERE pe.publish_status = 'FAILED' UNION ALL SELECT po.created_at, 'P2' AS severity FROM t_payment_order po INNER JOIN t_payment_channel_config pcc ON pcc.channel_code = po.channel_code WHERE pcc.status = 'DISABLED' ) issue_sla WHERE (issue_sla.severity = 'P1' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 30) OR (issue_sla.severity = 'P2' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 120) ), 0) AS overdueIssueCount

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT po.created_at, 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_order po WHERE po.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' UNION ALL SELECT pnl.created_at, 'P1' AS severity FROM t_payment_notify_log pnl WHERE pnl.notify_status = '待处理' UNION ALL SELECT pe.created_at, 'P2' AS severity FROM t_payment_event pe WHERE pe.publish_status = 'FAILED' UNION ALL SELECT po.created_at, 'P2' AS severity FROM t_payment_order po INNER JOIN t_payment_channel_config pcc ON pcc.channel_code = po.channel_code WHERE pcc.status = 'DISABLED' ) issue_sla WHERE (issue_sla.severity = 'P1' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 30) OR (issue_sla.severity = 'P2' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 120)

SELECT issue_no AS issueNo, payment_order_id AS paymentOrderId, issue_type AS issueType, severity, CASE WHEN issue_type IN ('待回调未收口', '回调处理待跟进') THEN '支付后端值班组' WHEN issue_type = '下游事件发布失败' THEN '账务清结算联动组' WHEN issue_type = '命中停用渠道' THEN '渠道配置运营组' ELSE '支付运营组' END AS responsibilityGroup, CASE WHEN issue_type IN ('待回调未收口', '回调处理待跟进') THEN '支付后端值班' WHEN issue_type = '下游事件发布失败' THEN '账清结算联动值班' WHEN issue_type = '命中停用渠道' THEN '渠道配置运营' ELSE '支付运营' END AS receiver, CONCAT('支付异常 ', issue_no, ' 已超过 ', severity, ' SLA，请进入异常中心处理。') AS alertContent FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('ISSUE-WAIT-', po.payment_order_id) AS issue_no, po.payment_order_id, '待回调未收口' AS issue_type, 'P1' AS severity, po.created_at FROM t_payment_order po WHERE po.status = 'WAIT_CALLBACK' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ISSUE-NOTIFY-', pnl.notify_no) AS issue_no, pnl.payment_order_id, '回调处理待跟进' AS issue_type, 'P1' AS severity, pnl.created_at FROM t_payment_notify_log pnl WHERE pnl.notify_status = '待处理' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ISSUE-EVENT-', pe.event_no) AS issue_no, pe.payment_order_id, '下游事件发布失败' AS issue_type, 'P2' AS severity, pe.created_at FROM t_payment_event pe WHERE pe.publish_status = 'FAILED' UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('ISSUE-CHANNEL-', po.payment_order_id) AS issue_no, po.payment_order_id, '命中停用渠道' AS issue_type, 'P2' AS severity, po.created_at FROM t_payment_order po INNER JOIN t_payment_channel_config pcc ON pcc.channel_code = po.channel_code WHERE pcc.status = 'DISABLED' ) issue_sla WHERE ((issue_sla.severity = 'P1' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 30) OR (issue_sla.severity = 'P2' AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, issue_sla.created_at, NOW()) >= 120)) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_payment_issue_alert_log alert_log WHERE alert_log.issue_no = issue_sla.issue_no AND alert_log.ack_status = '待确认' ) ORDER BY issue_sla.created_at ASC, issue_no ASC

SELECT task_log_no AS taskLogNo, task_code AS taskCode, task_name AS taskName, run_mode AS runMode, task_status AS taskStatus, task_status_type AS taskStatusType, processed_count AS processedCount, success_count AS successCount, fail_count AS failCount, summary_comment AS summaryComment, triggered_by AS triggeredBy, DATE_FORMAT(started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS startedAt, DATE_FORMAT(completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS completedAt FROM t_payment_task_run_log ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_payment_task_run_log ( task_log_no, task_code, task_name, run_mode, task_status, task_status_type, severity_level, severity_level_type, escalation_status, escalation_status_type, processed_count, success_count, fail_count, summary_comment, suggested_action, recommended_route, triggered_by, started_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{taskLogNo}, #{taskCode}, #{taskName}, #{runMode}, #{taskStatus}, #{taskStatusType}, #{severityLevel}, #{severityLevelType}, #{escalationStatus}, #{escalationStatusType}, #{processedCount}, #{successCount}, #{failCount}, #{summaryComment}, #{suggestedAction}, #{recommendedRoute}, #{triggeredBy}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO t_payment_issue_alert_log ( alert_no, issue_no, payment_order_id, issue_type, severity, responsibility_group, alert_channel, receiver, alert_status, alert_status_type, ack_status, ack_status_type, alert_content, triggered_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{alertNo}, #{issueNo}, #{paymentOrderId}, #{issueType}, #{severity}, #{responsibilityGroup}, #{alertChannel}, #{receiver}, #{alertStatus}, #{alertStatusType}, #{ackStatus}, #{ackStatusType}, #{alertContent}, #{triggeredBy}, NOW() )
